 │ ✓ Welcome                │ │  Your agent's key                                                                     │

 │ ✓ Sign in to Candle      │ │  Your agent trades with a key of its own, made by Candle's CLI and stored straight    │ 
 │  Wall…1111 · candle-     │ │  into the Candle Harness. It never shows on screen.                                   │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ ✓ Connect your agent     │ │  ▸ name       agent-a▏                                                                │ 
 │                          │ │    runs on   Claude Code · sonnet, from step 2                                        │ 
 │ ▸ Wallet and limits      │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │   – a vault, or not      │ │  Candle's cap on the key, optional                                                    │ 
 │   ▸ its key              │ │    cap        $50        a day · past it, Candle refuses buys and swaps · empty for…  │ 
 │   · its wallet           │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │   · limits               │ │  It runs, in the pane:                                                                │ 
 │   · approvals            │ │    candle keys create --label agent-a --tx-limit 50 --reset daily                     │ 
 │   · fund it              │ │    no vault: approved by you in the pane                                              │ 
 │                          │ │    then your approval in the browser, if Candle asks                                  │
